correctness.rationale: For any finite binary output word membership is exactly nonempty image of all four de Bruijn vertices under the labelled subset automaton. Factoriality makes minimal forbidden iff its (n-1)-prefix/suffix exist but the word does not. The productive paired-subset DFA with explicit first and last symbol recognizes unique offenders, including independent letter multiplicities. Strongly connected component structure rigorously differentiates finite, bounded one-cycle, two-cycle polynomial and branching-cycle exponential path growth for all lengths. Independent from-scratch graph reimplementation over all 256 truth tables reproduces exact 176/28/52 and longest acyclic 10 at 57,99,156,198, with no polynomial SCC chain in this family. Inspected full verify.py proves four eventual-periodic bounded forms by exact repeated entire transfer vectors, not finite sampling. Direct length<=9 enumerations corroborate but are not infinite proofs.

value.rationale: The growth of minimal forbidden words is a natural symbolic dynamics complexity invariant. A complete exhaustive catalogue of all 256 binary radius-one image languages, including a gap ruling out polynomial offender proliferation and a sharp finite-length cutoff, resolves an interpretable structural classification not merely isolated machine outputs. The all-length graph certificates justify the finite theorem.
